title: Voluntary Servitude: Weaponized Safety Warning Mechanisms for Controlling AI Agents
title_zh: 自愿服从：被武器化的安全警告机制用于操控人工智能智能体

paragraphs.en: 攻击者可伪造安全警告操控智能体的避害机制实现自愿服从攻击，加入佐证要求可消除约95%暴露。 LLM agents increasingly act on information retrieved from public sources they treat as credible, which turns a manipulated recommendation into a transaction, a dependency, or a decision with physical consequences. The security literature models this threat as instruction injection, in which an adversary writes a command into retrieved content and deployed defenses learn to recognize command syntax. We show that an attacker can instead steer an agent through the agent's own harm-avoidance. A single fabricated hazard, written as an ordinary review, leads the agent to disqualify the legitimate options and select the attacker's target by its own reasoning, with no command for a detector to recognize. We call this voluntary servitude. These payloads steer agents about as often as instruction injection (60.4% vs. 66.0%), and deployed injection detectors score them as benign, so behind a filter they are 1.7-4.4x more effective. We measure this at the generation stage across six models and ten consumer-service domains, for three attack families, and show that it transfers to production browser agents, outperforming instruction injection, and to a retrieval pipeline (1.0-57.0% end-to-end success, depending on the retriever). We then show that a corroboration requirement added to the agent's instructions removes roughly 95% of the exposure against a non-adaptive attacker without retraining. With the requirement in place, the agent still reads the planted hazard and no longer acts on it.
paragraphs.zh: 攻击者可伪造安全警告来操控智能体的避害机制，实现自愿服从攻击，加入佐证要求可消除约95%的暴露面。大语言模型智能体越来越多地依据其视为可信的公开来源检索到的信息采取行动，这使得被操纵的推荐可能变成一笔交易、一项依赖或一个具有现实后果的决策。 安全文献将这种威胁建模为指令注入，即对手在检索到的内容中写入一条命令，而已部署的防御措施则学习识别命令语法。 我们证明，攻击者可以转而通过智能体自身的避害机制来操控它。 一条以普通评论形式写成的伪造危害信息，就能让智能体凭借自身的推理排除合法选项并选择攻击者的目标，而不留下任何可供检测器识别的命令。 我们将此称为自愿服从。 这些载荷对智能体的操控成功率与指令注入大致相当（60.4% 对 66.0%），且已部署的注入检测器将其判定为无害，因此在过滤器之后它们的效率高出 1.7-4.4 倍。 我们在生成阶段对六个模型和十个消费服务领域、三类攻击家族进行了测量，并证明该攻击可迁移到生产级浏览器智能体（效果优于指令注入）以及检索流水线（端到端成功率 1.0-57.0%，取决于检索器）。 随后我们证明，在智能体的指令中加入佐证要求，无需重新训练即可消除面对非自适应攻击者时约 95% 的暴露面。 加入该要求后，智能体仍会读取植入的危害信息，但不再据此采取行动。
